title: Circuit boards etched at the Node Beta workshop from the pilot's own stored silicon ore and carbon ore bought there, kept in its storage for the faction's ladder (the reserve)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-17 04:05 UTC (orders.log ENT-027, block APOLLO: the 75 circuit boards first, then beyond; orders T4: by a route, not by hand). carbon_arc_circuit_etching makes 3 circuit boards from 2 silicon ore and 12 carbon ore by hand at the station workshop, 0 cr, about 5.6 ticks a run (16 runs, 48 boards in 16.0 minutes on 2026-11-17 01:44 to 02:01 UTC by stage.py of the skill logistics-stock). Three loads of 60 carbon ore are bought at the Node Beta ask (4 cr for 146,304 units, book of 04:02 UTC; one unit was bought first on 2026-11-17 01:42 UTC, rule F12) and stored, then 15 runs take 30 silicon and 180 carbon: 45 boards. The carbon is booked as money paid once (craft inputs, requests.log ENT-187). requires.stored sends only a pilot with 30 silicon ore in its own storage at Node Beta. One ship.
